hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; if [ -f "$d/src/cli/checkout.ts" ]; then exec node "$d/src/cli/main.ts" checkout hook; fi; if orch checkout list --json >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null; then exec orch checkout hook; fi; echo "orch checkout guard is INACTIVE here: this branch has no src/cli/checkout.ts and the installed orch has no checkout command.
